$comment: Enrollment is a PREDICATE over rows, never a stored population. There is deliberately no count field anywhere in this file or in the guard that reads it — pricing this contract against a hardcoded '21 repositories' survived several revisions before a live org census returned 52, so every cadence and blast estimate had been computed over the wrong set. Derive the population by sweeping the org and applying `rules`; never cache the answer as an integer.

rules.defaultRationale: Absence from this registry means UNDECIDED, never exempt. A repo is enrolled only by an explicit row, and excluded only by an explicit row carrying a reason. Silence is not a decision — that asymmetry is the whole point of a registry predicate.
rules.candidateScope: owned, non-archived repositories in the neomjs organization
rules.forks: not-enrolled by default; a fork carries upstream's substrate and a sync would fight it
rules.populationDerivation: org sweep at read time, filtered by `rules` and overridden by `repositories`. Never persisted as a number.

neo.note: The canonical tree is authored here and promoted to neomjs/neo-agent-skills. It is also an ordinary consumer of the receipt, so it carries one like any other enrolled repo.

devindex.note: Carries a hand-copied AGENTS.md and NO .agents/skills at all. Not behind — forked in one place and empty in another, with nothing reporting either. This is the red control for the guard: measured RED against real HEAD 5a5e1f0, failing on both the absent receipt and the underivable projection.

neo-agent-brain.reason: Extraction DESTINATION, not a stale consumer. Created 2026-08-23 as a scaffold (neomjs/neo#17640) awaiting the AgentOS cut; its lack of .agents/skills was a repo that had not received its content yet, not invisible staleness. Enrolling it pre-cut puts canonical-synced bytes on paths the cut (neomjs/neo#17786, #17788) is about to populate, creating two claims on one path in the window that matters most. Skill-tree custody after the cut is a question ADR 0040 never dispositioned and ADR 0041 should not have answered unilaterally — it belongs to the cut. Re-evaluate for enrollment AFTER the cut lands.

neo-agent-skills.reason: This IS the canonical store. A store cannot be a consumer of itself; the receipt it publishes is the thing consumers are measured against.
